## Executive Summary
Naboraj Sarkar is a student, builder, and developer operating from West Bengal, India under the personal brand and digital system **NS CODEX**. His primary mission is empowering Indian and global learners through **free, high-quality coding education** while engineering intelligent bot automation pipelines, event-driven software backends, and 3D spatial web interfaces.

## Selected Systems & Projects

### 1. NS CODEX Authority Node (PRJ-01)
- **Category**: Web & 3D
- **Status**: ACTIVE
- **Description**: High-performance personal digital system and 3D knowledge terminal engineered with React 19, Framer Motion, and WebGL shaders. Full JSON-LD entity integration and command palette navigation.
- **Stack**: React 19, TypeScript, Framer Motion, Tailwind CSS, Vite, Schema.org
- **Repository**: https://github.com/naborajs/personal-3d-portfolio-template
- **Live URL**: https://naborajsarkar-me.vercel.app/

### 2. Neuro-Mimetic Bot Suite (PRJ-02)
- **Category**: AI & Automation
- **Status**: OPEN SOURCE
- **Description**: Multi-channel intelligent automation agents for Telegram and WhatsApp using OpenAI pipelines, Python webhooks, and CRM data sync.
- **Stack**: Python, OpenAI API, Telegram Bot API, WhatsApp Business API, Node.js, Webhooks

### 3. Spatial Experience Engine (PRJ-03)
- **Category**: Web & 3D
- **Status**: ACTIVE
- **Description**: Lightweight WebGL and Three.js visual experiments exploring real-time lighting, interactive particle systems, and liquid glass refraction on browser canvas.
- **Stack**: Three.js, WebGL, GLSL Shaders, React, Canvas API

### 4. Open Education Codex for India (PRJ-04)
- **Category**: Education
- **Status**: ACTIVE
- **Description**: Non-profit curriculum initiative guiding students across India from ICSE computer science fundamentals to modern full-stack web and AI engineering through free guides and YouTube tutorials.
- **Stack**: Markdown, Open Education, Python, JavaScript, Git
- **Channel**: https://youtube.com/@Nishant_sarkar

### 5. Global Pipeline & Webhook Bridge (PRJ-05)
- **Category**: Integration
- **Status**: OPEN SOURCE
- **Description**: Event routing middleware connecting payment gateways (Stripe), Node-RED flows, database webhooks, and analytics dashboards with exponential backoff retries.
- **Stack**: Node.js, Express, Redis, Stripe API, Node-RED, REST APIs

### 6. Security Forge Protocol (PRJ-06)
- **Category**: Systems
- **Status**: EXPERIMENTAL
- **Description**: Edge security hardening, TLS/SSL blueprints, and authentication templates for modern web apps.
- **Stack**: Cybersecurity, TLS/SSL, Node.js, Nginx, Docker
